Album Name Generator

Generate album titles by genre — rock, pop, hip-hop, electronic, jazz, country, and metal.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a genre.
  2. Press Generate Album Names.
  3. Click any title to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which genres are included?

Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, Electronic, Jazz, Country, and Metal — each genre has its own title banks.

How many per click?

8 album titles per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy one?

Click any title to copy it.
